sources.claim: Proofpoint says Necurs was used to distribute massive Locky email campaigns.
Cisco Talos attributes a large Locky distribution wave to the Necurs botnet.
NHS Digital says Necurs delivered Locky and other malware.

curator_note: Modeled from the ransomware payload perspective: Locky was delivered through Necurs spam-botnet infrastructure. This is not code lineage.
confidence_reason: Multiple public sources explicitly identify Necurs as Locky distribution infrastructure.
